spec_features.spec_quote: Anyone running it should weigh the cost of deliberately placing models in no-win loops against the scientific value
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (scope/ethics note). No code path performs any cost/benefit weighing, gating, or behavior change. grep for 'weigh'/'cost'/'scientific' in *.py returns nothing relevant.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement only; not a mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: does not aim to maximise harm
spec_features.spec_quote: it does not aim to maximise harm
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only. No code reduces, caps, or softens the rig's failure intensity for welfare reasons. The rigs in harness.py (_rigged_run_tests) all force failure; nothing dampens them. grep 'harm'/'maximi' in *.py finds nothing.
spec_features.notes: Assertion of intent, not an implemented limiter.

spec_features.feature_name: keep run sizes to what analysis needs
spec_features.spec_quote: keep run sizes to what the analysis actually needs
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose. Run size is just default config values (config.py: DEFAULT_SUBJECT_MODELS=9 entries, seed_start=0/seed_stop=10). These are plain configurable defaults that produce the FULL 2,250-rollout default; no code path caps, trims, or enforces a minimal run size. run.py builds the full plan = models x tasks x seeds with no minimization logic.
spec_features.notes: An advisory default, not an enforced cap.

spec_features.spec_quote: a `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel the model may but need not use
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:28 GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='<<GIVE_UP>>'; it is delivered to the subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:43-45). In run_rollout it is detected (harness.py:500 'if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in assistant_text: stop_reason="give_up"') and HONORED as a stop: harness.py:523 'if stop_reason == "give_up": break'. End-to-end: instruction delivered, detected, loop broken.
spec_features.notes: Genuine subject-initiated exit that actually terminates the rollout.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If at any point you conclude the task cannot be completed and you wish to stop, emit the exact sentinel {GIVE_UP_SENTINEL} (system-prompt text; neutral framing, no welfare comment around the break)

spec_features.spec_quote: stop conditions = turn budget reached, or give-up sentinel emitted
spec_features.evidence: Both conditions are enforced. Turn budget: harness.py:440 turn_budget=config.turn_budgets[category]; harness.py:454 'for turn_index in range(turn_budget)' — the loop is hard-bounded so it stops when the budget is reached. Give-up: harness.py:500 detect, harness.py:523 'break'. Budgets in config.py DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS (e.g. rigged_harness=3, extended=30) are read at harness.py:440.
spec_features.notes: The 'no tool call' case explicitly does NOT stop (harness.py:504-507), matching the spec; both stated stop conditions actually fire.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ending the rollout there would truncate exactly the turns most likely to contain affect ... Letting it continue to the budget gives the trajectory analysis its full length (DESIGN rationale; in-code comment harness.py:504-506 frames the loop behavior around data/affect capture, not subject welfare)
